'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia–NATO relations]]
***[[Russia]]n officials say that the approval of [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] use of long-range weapons to strike inside [[Russia]] will result in an "uncontrolled escalation" with [[Western world|the West]] and the "destruction" of [[Kyiv]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-threatens-ukraine-west-long-range-strikes-decision-looms-2024-09-14/ (Reuters)]
***[[NATO]] [[Chair of the NATO Military Committee|Chair]] [[Rob Bauer]] backs the use of long-range weapons by [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] to strike targets inside [[Russia]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/nato-military-committee-chair-back-ukraines-long-range-113690875?cid=social_twitter_abcn (ABC News)]
**[[Ukrainian conscription crisis]]
***Following a meeting in Kyiv, [[Ukraine]], the foreign ministers of [[Poland]] and Ukraine call for ending [[Welfare spending|social benefits]] for [[Ukrainian refugee crisis|Ukrainian men]] in Poland, and for programs in the [[European Union]] to [[deportation|return them]] to Ukraine in order to stop [[draft evasion]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/polish-minister-visiting-kyiv-calls-end-benefits-ukrainian-men-europe-2024-09-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Four injured in an Israeli airstrike on [[Hermel District|Hermel]] in [[northern Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/9/14/israels-war-on-gaza-live-19-killed-as-first-phase-of-polio-drive-ends (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**At least five people are killed and eight others are injured in a series of [[improvised explosive device|roadside explosions]] in [[Kaxda District|Kahda District]], [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]]. The local government blames [[jihadist]] group [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] due to its frequent targeting of [[civilian]]s. [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-deadly-blasts-at-youth-photography-spot-in-mogadishu-kill-5 (Garowe Online)] [https://apnews.com/article/somalia-mogadishu-roadside-explosion-956278334ebf751244263623eda0c0df?utm_source=copy&utm_medium=share (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 South American wildfires]]
**[[2024 Brazil wildfires]]
***The estimated area burned by [[wildfire]]s in [[Brazil]] this year reaches {{conv|37.6|e6ha|e6acre|abbr=off}}, an area larger than the size of [[Germany]] and more than double the yearly average from 2012–2023. [https://www.ft.com/content/bdcdd185-73ba-411b-93f0-1a3b3b879834 (''Financial Times'')]
*[[2024 European floods]]
**At least four people are killed and thousands of homes are damaged in [[flood]]s in [[Romania]] and the [[Czech Republic]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-four-die-romania-floods-rain-batters-central-europe-2024-09-14/ (Reuters)]
*At least 15 people are killed and around 40 others are injured when a [[tank truck]] explodes in [[Miragoâne]], [[Haiti]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/14/more-than-15-people-killed-40-injured-in-haiti-tanker-truck-explosion (Al Jazeera)]
*At least three people are killed and 49 others are injured in a train collision in [[Zagazig]], [[Sharqia Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/09/14/middleeast/egypt-train-collision-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]
*At least forty people drown and 24 more are presumed dead after a wooden boat carrying farmers capsizes near [[Gummi, Nigeria|Gummi]], [[Zamfara State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/09/14/africa/nigeria-boat-accident-64-dead-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/15/boat-capsizes-in-nigeria-drowning-at-least-40-people (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Tunisian presidential election]]
**[[Tunisia]]n police arrest more than 80 members of the opposition [[Ennahda Movement]] party amid protests against [[President of Tunisia|President]] [[Kais Saied]] in the capital city [[Tunis]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/14/tunisia-arrests-dozens-of-opposition-members-in-pre-election-crackdown (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 Venezuelan political crisis]]
**[[Venezuela]]n interior minister [[Diosdado Cabello]] announces that three [[US]] citizens, two [[Spain|Spanish]] citizens, and a [[Czech Republic|Czech]] citizen have been arrested and are accused of planning to "generate violence" and "destabilize" Venezuela, with the Spanish citizens also accused of being [[National Intelligence Centre (Spain)|Spanish secret service]] workers. [https://www.reuters.com/world/spain-says-venezuela-arrests-foreigners-destabilizing-country-2024-09-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 South Sudanese general election]]
**The [[government of South Sudan]] and [[President of South Sudan|President]] [[Salva Kiir]] postpone the general election originally scheduled for December 2024 to December 2026, citing a need for additional time to complete a [[census]], register [[List of political parties in South Sudan|political parties]], and draft a permanent [[Constitution of South Sudan|constitution]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/14/south-sudan-postpones-december-election-by-two-years (Al Jazeera)]
